analyst.summary: Valor Estate (formerly D B Realty) has meaningfully cut its debt and finally received the occupation certificate for its long-delayed Ten BKC project in Mumbai, both genuine positives. However, even with that project's revenue now booked, the company's overall return on capital remains negative, and its earnings are too small and lumpy (driven by one-off project completions) to support the very high reported price-to-earnings ratio. We see this as a still-speculative turnaround story rather than one to hold through.
